title: 第023章 残琴归骨承千古，清音续脉镇魔渊
content_zh:
“文姬文姬！它太狡猾了！”梦奇气呼呼地抱怨道。

    蔡文姬眼神紧盯，心念微动，【思无邪】瞬间催动。

    淡白色的净化音波骤然铺开，形成一个巨大的光罩，将整个阁楼笼罩在内。

    所有的黑丝都被困在光罩之中，无处可逃。

    黑雾剧烈翻滚起来，发出刺耳的嘶鸣。

    与净化音波激烈碰撞，滋滋的声响在空旷的阁楼里刺耳回荡。

    蔡文姬全神贯注！

    深感这缕魔气比之前遇到的任何一缕都要精纯。

    显然是从魔渊深处直接逸散而出，并非邪修沾染的残次品。

    她指尖微微用力，加大了净化之力的输出。

    体内刚恢复不久的灵气，再次飞速消耗。

    经脉中残留的黑色纹路，隐隐作痛。

    一口淡黑色的血气，涌上喉咙，被她强行咽了回去。

    “文姬文姬，我帮你呦！”

    梦奇扑到光罩上，张开小嘴大口大口地吞吃着黑雾。

    它的小脸越来越黑，小肚子也越来越鼓，却还是不肯停下。

    就在这时。

    高台上的残破古琴，突然爆发出一道璀璨的金色光芒。

    无数古老的音符从琴身飞出。

    如同金色的利剑，径直刺穿了那缕黑雾。

    黑雾发出一声凄厉的惨叫，瞬间消散得无影无踪。

    连一丝痕迹都没有留下。

    金色音符在空中盘旋一周，缓缓落在蔡文姬的掌心。

    化作一点温暖的金光，融入她的体内。

    蔡文姬只觉得浑身一暖。

    经脉中的刺痛感瞬间消失，原本滞涩的胡笳仙骨，变得无比灵动。

    渡厄琴骨的凝实度，凭空提升了三成。

    梦奇打了个饱嗝，吐出一团白色的雾气，拍了拍小肚子：“终于吃完了！这个坏气气难吃死了！”

    蔡文姬缓步走上高台，看着那张残破的古琴。

    体内的胡笳仙骨，震颤得愈发剧烈。

    她伸出手，轻轻触碰在残琴之上。

    指尖刚一碰到琴身，残琴便猛地爆发出一道耀眼的金色光芒。

    无数金色的音符，从残琴中飞出，围绕着蔡文姬，欢快地旋转飞舞。

    梦奇也兴奋地在音符之间穿梭，时不时伸手抓一个音符塞进嘴里。
content_en:
"Wenji Wenji! It's so cunning!" Meng Qi complained angrily.

    Cai Wenji stared closely, her mind moved slightly, and [Siwuxie] activated instantly.

    The pale white purifying sound waves suddenly spread out, forming a huge light shield that enveloped the entire attic.

    All the black threads are trapped in the mask of light, with nowhere to escape.

    The black mist rolled violently, making a shrill scream.

    It collided fiercely with the purifying sound waves, and the sizzling sound echoed harshly in the empty attic.

    Cai Wenji is fully focused!

    I feel deeply that this ray of demonic energy is purer than any other ray I have encountered before.

    It obviously escaped directly from the depths of the Demonic Abyss and was not a defective product contaminated by evil cultivators.

    She exerted slight pressure on her fingertips to increase the output of the purifying power.

    The spiritual energy that had just been restored in the body was quickly consumed again.

    The remaining black lines in the meridians ached faintly.

    A mouthful of light black blood surged up into her throat, and she swallowed it back forcefully.

    "Wenji Wenji, let me help you!"

    Meng Qi threw himself on the light mask, opened his small mouth and swallowed the black mist in big mouthfuls.

    Its little face is getting darker and darker, and its belly is getting more and more bulging, but it still refuses to stop.

    Just then.

    The broken guqin on the high platform suddenly erupted with a bright golden light.

    Countless ancient notes flew out from the piano body.

    Like a golden sword, it pierced through the black mist.

    The black mist let out a shrill scream and instantly dissipated without a trace.

    Not even a trace was left.

    The golden note circled in the air and slowly landed on Cai Wenji's palm.

    It turned into a little warm golden light and blended into her body.

    Cai Wenji felt warm all over.

    The tingling sensation in the meridians disappeared instantly, and the originally stagnant Hujia Immortal Bone became extremely agile.

    The solidity of the Du'eqin bone increased by 30% out of thin air.

    Meng Qi burped, spit out a cloud of white mist, and patted his belly: "Finally finished eating! This bad gas is so unpalatable!"

    Cai Wenji walked up to the high platform slowly and looked at the broken guqin.

    The Hujia Immortal Bone in the body was trembling more and more violently.

    She stretched out her hand and gently touched the broken piano.

    As soon as the fingertips touched the piano body, the broken piano suddenly erupted into a dazzling golden light.

    Countless golden notes flew out from the broken piano, spinning and dancing happily around Cai Wenji.

    Mengqi also shuttled between the notes excitedly, reaching out to grab a note and stuffing it into his mouth from time to time.
title_en: Chapter 023 The broken harp returns to the bones and will be passed down through the ages, and the clear sound continues the pulse to suppress the demonic abyss.
